predecessor.availability: Git history only; predecessor downloads are excluded from the current production tree.

authorization_scope: The owner explicitly authorized committing and pushing the new English whitepaper and website to main and publishing rldcoin.com, with only the current publication on the production site. Git history and local predecessor bytes are retained. No mainnet start or protocol repository change is authorized.
qualification: Design requirements and proposed mechanisms only. No implementation, mainnet, independent-operation or physical-route qualification.

model_limits: Five finite contract models under explicit ideal guards and supplemental boundary cases; some properties hold by construction.
Not implementation verification, whole-system proof, formal refinement, two independent full verifiers, authenticated protocol adoption or mainnet qualification.

Single-active fencing alone does not prevent stale restored state from consuming authority again. An equivalent fencing branch must preserve consumed authority and a complete current prefix, reconcile uncertain outbound effects, and establish failure atomicity; that equivalence is not proved by these finite models.
